name: @blackunicorn/eslint-plugin-edge
description: ESLint plugin enforcing edge-runtime-safe code in BonkLM connectors (bans bare process.env in edge-reachable files)
publishJustification: Consumed by downstream connector authors to lint their own edge-reachable code with the same rules BonkLM applies internally. Required so consumer monorepos can opt into the no-bare-process.env enforcement that defines edge-portability.

scripts.prepublishOnly: git diff --quiet HEAD -- . || (echo 'prepublishOnly: dirty working tree in plugin dir — commit or stash before publish' && exit 1) && npm run clean && npm run build && npm test

author: Black Unicorn <info@blackunicorn.tech>
